operation.description:
Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. List incomes, most recent first.

Returns a paginated array under `data[]`, each entry wrapped in an `Income` object, plus a `pagination` summary. Only income records are returned (expense records are served by the separate expenses endpoints).

Results can be narrowed with the query filters below and ordered with `sort`/`direction`. Some filters depend on the account's configuration or enabled plugins, as noted per parameter.

**Access:** available to the account owner, or to staff holding any of the *View His Own Incomes*, *Add New Incomes*, or *Edit/Delete His Own Incomes* permissions. Staff without *View All Incomes* or *Edit/Delete All Incomes* see only incomes they recorded.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format suffix appended to the path, e.g. `.json`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of items per page (1–1000). Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number to retrieve. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Field to order the results by (e.g. `date`, `amount`, `id`).

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Sort direction: `asc` or `desc`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Filter by exact income id.

parameters.name: expense_number
parameters.description: Filter by income number / reference code (partial match).

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Start of the income-date range (inclusive), in the account's date format.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: End of the income-date range (inclusive), in the account's date format.

parameters.name: created_from
parameters.description: Start of the created-date range (inclusive).

parameters.name: created_to
parameters.description: End of the created-date range (inclusive).

parameters.name: amount_from
parameters.description: Minimum amount (inclusive).

parameters.name: amount_to
parameters.description: Maximum amount (inclusive).

parameters.name: note
parameters.description: Filter by words in the description / note (partial match; multiple words all must match).

parameters.name: expense_category_id
parameters.description: Filter by income category reference.

parameters.name: vendor
parameters.description: Filter by exact vendor name. Available only when the account has recorded vendors.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Filter to a single client. Available when the account is not configured to hide the client field on incomes.

parameters.name: journal_account_id
parameters.description: Filter by journal (chart-of-accounts) account. Matches the income's account or any of its per-line accounts. Available when the account is configured to hide the client field on incomes.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Filter by status.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| issued | Issued (posted) |
| draft | Draft |

parameters.name: work_order_id
parameters.description: Filter to incomes linked to a specific work order.

parameters.name: recurring_expense_id
parameters.description: Filter to incomes generated from a specific recurring income.

parameters.name: creation_method
parameters.description:
Filter by how the income was created.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| ai | Only AI-generated incomes |
| (other) | Only incomes that were not AI-generated |

parameters.name: staff_id
parameters.description: Filter by the staff member who recorded the income. Available only when the Staff plugin is enabled and the caller holds the *View All Incomes* permission; otherwise ignored.

parameters.name: is_mileage
parameters.description:
Filter by record type. Available only when the Mileage plugin is enabled.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Regular income |
| 1 | Mileage |

file.description: Legacy single-file attachment reference. May be empty.

client_id.description: Reference of the linked client, when applicable. May be null.

supplier_id.description: Reference of the linked supplier, when applicable. May be null.

staff_id.description: Staff member who recorded the income; `0` indicates the account owner.

recurring_expense_id.description: Reference of the recurring income this record was generated from; `0` if none.

modified.description: Time the income was last updated.

tax1_id.description: First tax reference. May be null.

tax1_included.description:
Whether the first tax is included in the amount.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Added on top |
| 1 | Included |

tax2_id.description: Second tax reference. May be null.

tax2_included.description:
Whether the second tax is included in the amount.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Added on top |
| 1 | Included |

is_income.description:
Record type.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Income |
| 1 | Income |

treasury_id.description: Treasury the amount was deposited into.

work_order_id.description: Reference of the linked work order, when applicable. May be null.

source_id.description: Reference of the originating record, when the income was generated from another entity. May be null.

source_type.description: Type of the originating record, when generated from another entity. May be null.

expense_category_id.description: Reference of the income category; `0` if uncategorised.

journal_account_id.description: Journal (chart-of-accounts) account reference. May be null.

accounts_data.description: Per-line account allocation, as a JSON-encoded string. Populated for draft records.

status.description:
Record status.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| issued | Issued (posted) |
| draft | Draft |

extra_details.description: Additional processing metadata, as a JSON-encoded string.

prev.description: URL of the previous page, or null on the first page.

next.description: URL of the next page, or null on the last page.

403.description: The authenticated user lacks permission to view incomes.
